kitchen.name: Farmhouse Kitchen
kitchen.desc: Adds a kitchen to your farmhouse so you can cook.

hatchery.name: Hatchery
hatchery.desc: Incubates up to 2 eggs at a time.

big_hatchery.name: Big Hatchery
big_hatchery.desc: Incubates up to 4 eggs, and they hatch a day sooner.

greenhouse.name: Greenhouse
greenhouse.desc: Repairs the old greenhouse. Crops grow there in any season.

south_field.name: South Field
south_field.desc: Clears the fence to open up the southern field.

lakeside.name: Lakeside Plot
lakeside.desc: Opens up the lakeside land in the southeast.

terrace.name: Hilltop Terrace
terrace.desc: Builds stairs to a big new terrace above your farm.

auto_shipper.name: Auto-Shipper
auto_shipper.desc: Each night, the farm chest's contents are shipped automatically.

wildling_spa.name: Wildling Spa
wildling_spa.desc: Working Wildlings fully recover energy every night and gain happiness.
